description: sing-box 的 Windows 图形客户端（官方安装器版，含系统服务） | Windows GUI client for sing-box, installed with the official installer including the system service
notes_cn: 机器级安装：使用官方 NSIS 安装器装到 C:\Program Files\sing-box，安装、更新、卸载都需要管理员权限，请在提权终端里执行 scoop 命令
安装器会注册 sing-box-daemon 系统服务（LocalSystem、自动启动），TUN 模式不再需要每次提权
程序在 C:\Program Files\sing-box；GUI 数据在 C:\ProgramData\sing-box，服务数据在 C:\ProgramData\sing-box-daemon
卸载默认保留数据；要一并清除请手动运行 Uninstall sing-box.exe 并加 --delete-app-data
不能与便携版（解包安装）共存：同名服务 sing-box-daemon 与同一份数据目录会冲突
notes: Machine-wide install: the official NSIS installer places files in C:\Program Files\sing-box; install, update and uninstall all require administrator rights, so run scoop from an elevated terminal
The installer registers the sing-box-daemon system service (LocalSystem, automatic start), so TUN mode no longer needs elevation each time
Program files live in C:\Program Files\sing-box; GUI data in C:\ProgramData\sing-box and service data in C:\ProgramData\sing-box-daemon
Data is kept on uninstall; to remove it as well, run Uninstall sing-box.exe with --delete-app-data
Cannot coexist with the portable (unpacked) build: the sing-box-daemon service name and data directories collide
